note: What a server sends about the effect in one slot of several units at once. The header names no object it acts on: the units are listed below.

fields.name: runningFor
fields.note: How long the effect has already run, in seconds.

fields.name: lasts
fields.note: How long it runs in total, in seconds.

fields.name: count
fields.note: How many units follow.

fields.name: entries
unit
fields.note: The unit carrying the effect.

fields.name: caster
fields.note: The unit that put it there.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the unit's effect slots.
The units, one place each.

revisions.note: A client takes each entry as it takes an EffectReplaced for that unit, with the two times above.
